description: This source file contains a set of tests for coverage dumping in a Swift project, specifically testing the periodic flushing of coverage profiles.

methods.name: periodically flush coverage
methods.description: An async test method that checks whether the coverage profile is periodically written to by executing a loop until a deadline, trying to write the profile and sleeping between attempts.

methods.name: resolveProfileWriteFile
methods.description: A function that dynamically looks up the '__llvm_profile_write_file' symbol and returns a Swift function pointer to invoke it.
